To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Auto-Pipe is an application design tool that aids in designing, evaluating and implementing applications that execute on computational pipelines (topologies other than a pipeline are also supported) using a set (heterogeneous) of devices including multiple processors, FPGAs, etc.

Auto-Pipe is an integrated design environment for heterogeneous systems, that it is based on a novel design language called X, and that it is being used to design and evaluate a variety of real-world applications.
we have developed Auto-Pipe to assist the design, evaluation, and implementation of applications for a computational pipeline using a heterogeneous set of devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a design tool for the specification, analysis and implementation of applications on heterogeneous computing systems that can be represented as pipelines.
the design of a tool for rapid design and implementation of heterogeneous systems.
the design and implementation of systems that can be executed in parallel on multiple heterogeneous devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Auto-Pipe is not a tool for the faint of heart, but for those who are willing to learn a new language, it can provide a very flexible and powerful tool for the design and evaluation of heterogeneous systems.
the design flow and X design language provide the necessary functionality and expressiveness required for the design of a wide variety of computational pipelines.
Auto-Pipe is an innovative tool that is well on its way to becoming a powerful design tool for the development of heterogeneous computational systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a tool that allows the designer to explore the design space for applications that can be described as pipelines, and to evaluate the performance of alternative designs.
the Auto-Pipe project has been very successful in providing a tool for the design and evaluation of applications for computational pipelines.
the Auto-Pipe tool is a powerful design environment for the rapid development of heterogeneous computational systems.

the Auto-Pipe tool and the X language provide the designer of computational pipeline systems a complete set of tools for design and implementation.
the Auto-Pipe system can be used as a general purpose design tool for a wide range of computational pipeline applications.
Auto-Pipe is an effective tool for designing and evaluating computational pipeline applications.
